headline: SoftBank Wants to Buy America’s Biggest Security Guard Company and Use Robots
summary: SoftBank is eyeing an $18 billion deal to take over the largest private security firm in America, with plans to swap out guards for robots at scale. The math only works if machines can do the job, and that question is far from settled.

headline: Teradyne (NASDAQ:TER) Shows High-Growth Fundamentals as Earnings Revisions and Sales Surge
summary: Teradyne (TER) clears Navellier’s growth screen with strong EPS revisions, earnings beats, sales growth, margins, cash flow and high ROE.
